brief:
Israel continues restricting deliveries of shelter materials and rubble-clearing equipment to Gaza more than a year after President Donald Trump announced a ceasefire plan to end the war, Al-Monitor reported. The restrictions undermine efforts to address the humanitarian crisis facing displaced Palestinians and obstruct reconstruction in the territory.

The limitations on aid shipments have drawn criticism as they conflict with Trump's stated objective of resolving the conflict. Shelter and debris removal remain critical needs across Gaza, where widespread destruction has left hundreds of thousands without adequate housing.
dek: More than a year after President Donald Trump announced a ceasefire to end the war in Gaza, Israel continues to restrict the delivery of shelter materials and rubble-clearing machinery.
title: Israel blocks shelter aid despite Trump's Gaza ceasefire plan
